Goodness-of-fit diagnostic plots from a NONMEM $TABLE file

Source: R/nm_gof.R
nm_gof.Rd

Reads a NONMEM output table (space/tab-delimited, possibly with repeated headers and multiple "TABLE NO." blocks), keeps the observation rows, and builds the standard goodness-of-fit diagnostics: observed vs predictions and residual plots (CWRES / NPDE / IWRES). Plots are only built when the required columns are present. Optionally writes all plots to a Word (.docx) file in the analysis directory.

Usage

nm_gof(
  file,
  pred = c("PRED", "CPRED"),
  time = c("TIME", "TAD"),
  by = NULL,
  loess = TRUE,
  reg = TRUE,
  se = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.5,
  log_pred = FALSE,
  stem = NULL,
  save_docx = FALSE,
  output_file = NULL,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 150,
  ...
)

Arguments

file

Path to a NONMEM table file, OR a run directory (.reg / .nm7 / any folder) inside which a NONMEM table is auto-detected. Since the table is not necessarily named "sdtab", detection is by content ("TABLE NO." header), optionally filtered by stem.

pred

Preference for the population prediction column used on x-axes. The first available name is used. Default c("PRED","CPRED"). Pass e.g. pred = "CPRED" to force one.

time

Preference for the time column used on residual-vs-time plots. Default c("TIME","TAD").

by

Optional character vector of column names for faceting (facet_wrap), e.g. c("SEX","CMT").

loess

Add a loess trend (default TRUE).

reg

Add a linear regression (default TRUE).

se

Show confidence band around the linear regression (default FALSE).

alpha

Point transparency (default 0.5).

log_pred

Log10 axes for the DV-vs-prediction plots (default FALSE).

stem

Optional filename stem to disambiguate auto-detection in a run directory (e.g. "sdtab", "patab"). Not required to be "sdtab".

save_docx

If TRUE, write all plots to a .docx in the analysis directory (default FALSE).

output_file

Output .docx path. If NULL and save_docx=TRUE, a name is derived from the table file, written next to it. (Formerly docx_file, still accepted with a warning.)

width, height, dpi

Image size (inches) and resolution for the docx export.

...

Former argument name, accepted with a warning until version 1.0.

Value

An object of class "nm_gof": a list with plots (named list of ggplot objects), data (the filtered observation rows), file, columns (resolved column mapping), skipped (plots that could not be built and why), and by.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
g <- nm_gof("C:/nm74g64/run/lopi_04.reg/lopi_04_03_04.fit")
g                       # summary
plot(g)                 # all panels
plot(g, type = "dv_pred")
nm_gof(".../run.reg", pred = "CPRED", by = "SEX", save_docx = TRUE)
} # }
